title: Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
body:
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Ghaibat Mein Mera Maula Sada Deta Hai Ro Ro Kar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
Mere Baba Ki Gardan Thi, Laeen Ka Kund Tha Khanjar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Jis Chhe Maah Ke Bachche Ne Ran Mein Teer Khaya Tha
Pas-E-Khaima Jise Shabbir Ne Ja Kar Chhupaya Tha
Laeen Ne Dasht Mein Dhoonda Tha Kaise Laasha-E-Asghar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Zamana Jis Ko Kehta Tha Shabeeh-E-Ahmad-E-Mursal
Ussi Mazloom Par Dhaya Gaya Mahshar Sar-E-Maqtal
Sitamgar Ne Kiya Naize Se Chhalni Seena-E-Akbar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Samaan-E-Ashoor Ka Dadi Meri Nazron Mein Rehta Hai
Ussi Gham Mein Meri Aankhon Se Ab Bhi Khoon Behta Hai
Haram Ke Jal Gaye Khaime, Phuphi Ki Chhin Gayi Chadar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tamaanche Maarta Tha Jab Laeen Bachi Ke Gaalon Par
Bulati Thi Wo Amu Jaan Ko Dariya Se Ro Ro Kar
Sada Ye Sun Ke Dariya Par Tadapta Tha Chacha Ka Sar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar-E-Aun O Muhammad Jab Nazar Aaye The Naize Par
Zara Royi Na Madar Apne Bachchon Ke Bichharne Par
Ali Akbar Ko Roti Thi Musalsal Zainab-E-Muztar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitam Ye Bhi Hua Maqtal Mein Jo Ek Shab Ka Dulha Tha
Ussi Ki Laash Ko Maidan Mein Ronda Tha, Wawayla
Simat Ke Kis Tarah Ghatri Mein Aaya Qasim-E-Shabbar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Nazron Mein Ab Tak Phirta Hai Bazaar Ka Manzar
Nabi Ki Aal Thi Ummat Ke Haathon Zulm Ki Zad Par
Kahin Maare Gaye Durre, Kahin Maare Gaye Patthar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere Baba Ka Kis Ne Kund Khanjar Se Gala Kaata
Pada Tha Dasht Mein Jis Waqt Be-Gor O Kafan Laasha
Wahan Kis Kis Ne Mitti Aan Ke Daali Thi Zakhmon Par
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jary Kehne Lage Mehdi Ke Main Jab Izn Paaunga
Hussain Ibn-E-Ali Ke Qaatilon Par Qahr Dhaaunga
Koi Qaatil Meri Talwar Se Jaayega Na Bach Kar
Mujhe Sab Yaad Hai Dadi
author: Jary Raza
